dubbing.title: Dubbing
dubbing.description: Convert translated dialogue into natural-sounding speech while preserving speaker flow.

tier1.title: Tier 1: Audio Separation & Pre-processing (Demucs Audio Separation)
tier1.desc: Separates original audio into Vocals (for STT & dubbing) and Background Music (BGM).
tier1.demucsFt: Meta Demucs v4 FT (Free - Good noise removal)
tier1.note: Demucs extracts Vocals (for speech recognition) and Background Music (for mixing with AI voice) independently.

tier2.title: Tier 2: Speech Recognition (Faster-Whisper STT)
tier2.desc: Converts audio to text with high accuracy and real-time word alignment.
tier2.whisperxLargeV3: WhisperX Large v3 (Free - Precise word timing)
tier2.note: AI speech recognition automatically transcribes dialogue accurately segment by segment.

tier3.title: Tier 3: Multilingual Translation (NLLB-200) & Glossary
tier3.desc: Coherent, natural translation preserving context and terminology.

tier4.title: Tier 4: AI Voice Dubbing (TTS Dubbing) & Speaker Assignment
tier4.desc: Clone original voice using XTTS v2 or use emotional Microsoft Neural Voices.
tier4.xttsUnsupported: Coqui XTTS-v2 does not support "{{lang}}". Edge-TTS or ElevenLabs recommended.

tier5.title: Tier 5: Subtitle Style Studio
tier5.desc: 100% synchronization of typography, alignment, animations, and on-screen placement.
tier5.bilingualDesc: Line 1 original speech, Line 2 translated text

tier6.title: Tier 6: Encoding & Video Export Studio
tier6.desc: Configure video quality, container formats, and GPU hardware encoder.
